changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.21
changeSet.comment: Drop the fixed statement bound from the registered stamp moves and P3.3a id-twin validation moves that are not complete (nexus-p2m1x.21; Sam's ruling, T2 nexus/sam-ruling-validate-bounds-lock-wait-only-2026-11-23): statement_timeout_ms 60000 becomes 2147483647, which the finisher reads as no statement bound and a 5 s lock wait. Their on_completes are VALIDATE CONSTRAINT (SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE), which blocks no writer. data-move-exempt: data_moves: the registry's own column, not a table that grows with user data. DATA EFFECT: at most 23 rows of the global registry nexus.data_moves have statement_timeout_ms set; no row of any other table changes; no DDL; reversible: the rollback restores 60000.
changeSet.sql: DO $s$ BEGIN UPDATE nexus.data_moves SET statement_timeout_ms = 2147483647 WHERE (label LIKE 'rdr229-stamp-%' OR label LIKE 'rdr229-fkvalidate-%') AND statement_timeout_ms = 60000 AND completed_at IS NULL; END $s$;

rollback.sql: DO $s$ BEGIN UPDATE nexus.data_moves SET statement_timeout_ms = 60000 WHERE (label LIKE 'rdr229-stamp-%' OR label LIKE 'rdr229-fkvalidate-%') AND statement_timeout_ms = 2147483647; END $s$;
